prompt: I'm building an Angular 21 project with Tailwind CSS v4. I need to add dark mode support. The app should respect the user's OS preference by default but also allow manual toggling via a button. Show me how to set this up with Tailwind v4's CSS-first configuration (no tailwind.config.js), including the toggle component and how to apply dark styles in templates.

assertions.name: no_tailwind_config_js
assertions.check: Output does not instruct creating tailwind.config.js

assertions.name: uses_v4_dark_mode
assertions.description: Uses Tailwind v4 dark mode approach
assertions.check: Output uses dark: variant classes in templates or @custom-variant in CSS

assertions.name: os_preference_detection
assertions.check: Output references prefers-color-scheme media query or equivalent

assertions.name: manual_toggle
assertions.check: Output includes a component or mechanism to manually switch between light and dark mode

assertions.name: uses_signals
assertions.description: Uses Angular signals for state management
assertions.check: Toggle state uses signal() or similar reactive primitive
